what: Real-AWS check of scripts/kill-all.ts and of how a run ends when its MicroVM is killed mid-run (Plan step 8).

part1_idle_vms.payload: empty (no key, no task, no model call)
part1_idle_vms.dry_run: listed both as RUNNING and terminated nothing
part1_idle_vms.after: list-microvms showed both TERMINATED; a second dry run found nothing to terminate

part2_real_run_killed_mid_run.agent_state_at_kill: agent working (about 7 s after submit; had emitted command output)
part2_real_run_killed_mid_run.outcome: run status 'error', stderr 'events poll failed: HTTP 502', then done(exit 1), 11 s after the kill command started

reading: A killed MicroVM surfaced as an HTTP 502 on the next poll, so the run failed fast. The per-request timeout added in Step 6 was NOT exercised by this scenario (no poll hung); it is covered by unit tests only. The 11 s includes the kill-all call and the time until the proxy began answering 502; it was not broken down further.
not_verified: A poll that actually hangs against real AWS; behaviour under suspend or network loss; N=1 for the mid-run kill.
